products.name: Calming Donut Cuddler Pet Bed
products.description: The viral anxiety-reducing bed. Ultra-soft faux fur and a raised rim give dogs and cats a sense of security for deeper, calmer sleep. Machine-washable and water-resistant base.

products.name: Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush
products.description: Press one button and the bristles retract for mess-free cleanup. Gently removes loose fur, tangles, and dander from dogs and cats without scratching the skin.

products.name: No-Pull Reflective Dog Harness
products.description: Vet-recommended front-clip design stops pulling without choking. Padded, breathable, and reflective for safe night walks. Adjustable in 4 points for the perfect fit.

products.name: Slow Feeder Anti-Gulp Bowl
products.description: The maze design makes pets eat up to 10x slower, easing bloat, vomiting, and obesity. Non-slip base, food-safe, and dishwasher friendly.

products.name: Smart Interactive Rolling Cat Ball
products.description: Self-rolling, USB-rechargeable ball with LED lights keeps cats chasing and active while you're away. Auto-sleep mode and obstacle sensing for hours of solo play.

products.name: Calming Silicone Lick Mat
products.description: Spread peanut butter or yogurt to soothe anxiety during baths, grooming, or nail trims. Strong suction cups lock it in place. Freezer-safe for long-lasting treats.

products.name: LED Rechargeable Safety Collar
products.description: Keep your dog visible up to 350m away on night walks. Three glow modes, USB-rechargeable, water-resistant, and adjustable for any size.

products.name: 2-in-1 Portable Dog Water Bottle
products.description: Leak-proof bottle with a flip-up bowl for fresh water anywhere — walks, road trips, the park. One-handed operation and a handy carry strap.

products.name: Enrichment Snuffle Feeding Mat
products.description: Hide kibble in the soft fabric folds to engage your dog's natural foraging instincts. Burns mental energy, reduces boredom, and slows fast eaters. Machine washable.

products.name: Waterproof Dog Car Seat Hammock
products.description: Protects your back seat from fur, mud, and scratches with a scratch-proof, waterproof hammock. Quick-release buckles, side flaps, and a non-slip backing. Fits most cars and SUVs.

products.name: Reusable Pet Hair Remover Roller
products.description: No tape, no refills, no waste. The self-cleaning roller lifts fur from couches, beds, and clothes, then empties into the built-in chamber. Endlessly reusable.

products.name: Gentle Deshedding Grooming Glove
products.description: Pet your pet, groom at the same time. 255 soft silicone tips remove loose fur while giving a soothing massage your dog or cat will actually enjoy. Doubles as a bath mitt.
